object_description: compact five-storey square volume around a central void
design_condition: The compact volume is aligned with the Route des Acacias to complete the large urban composition, freeing a substantial central playground and public square while pivoting toward the courtyard.

positive.statement: The location frees a large surface for a school playground and public space, creating a new neighborhood-scale centrality.

position.rationale: Open ground is approximated beside the compact volume, using the top footprint and low-level elevations.

positive.statement: The building and surrounding blocks define an open place whose objects dialogue without enclosing it.

position.rationale: The open urban area is placed adjacent to the building mass, where the sampled footprint leaves space.

positive.statement: The building is cleverly positioned to pivot toward the courtyard and affirm its institutional vocation.

position.rationale: The central courtyard and surrounding volume are identifiable in plan and corresponding elevations.

positive.statement: The open courtyard, covered courtyard and main access create a clear sequence.

position.target: open courtyard, covered courtyard and main access
position.rationale: The sequence is anchored toward the lower courtyard edge and entrance side of the sampled footprint.

positive.statement: The square plan organizes the entire program around a central void.

position.rationale: A central opening organizes the square plan and remains legible across plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The organization of the program by strata is clearly expressed on the facade through varying frame rhythms.

position.rationale: Repeated vertical frame rhythms are clearly sampled along the east-facing elevation at multiple levels.

positive.statement: The project provides a clear and well-founded response in implementation, program organization, facade treatment and external image.

position.rationale: The broad assessment is anchored to the complete compact volume and its visible envelope.

positive.statement: The sawtooth roof gives the school an iconic, radical and playful presence.

position.rationale: The roof edge and repeated upper profile identify the sawtooth feature at the northern roof area.

negative.statement: The compact vertical design produces a certain monumentality in the main facade and central void.

position.rationale: Monumentality is assigned to the prominent lower-facing facade and adjacent void edge.

negative.statement: The circulation spaces between the classrooms are oversized and insufficiently developed for children.

position.rationale: Interior circulation is not directly sampled, so it is approximated within the classroom-bearing central mass.

negative.statement: The administrative rooms placed between two technical areas are an unfortunate consequence of the rigid framework.

position.rationale: The internal room arrangement is inferred within the east-central volume between visible structural bands.
